newsitem.title: JAPAN: DKB loan suspension excludes overseas branches-MOF.
newsitem.headline: DKB loan suspension excludes overseas branches-MOF.

text.p: The Japanese Ministry of Finance's (MOF) suspension of the extending of any fresh loans by Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd (DKB), as a penalty for involvement in a racketeer payoff scandal, does not include lending by its overseas branches, a MOF official told reporters on Wednesday.
Earlier, MOF announced a number of penalties against DKB, including a suspension of new loan business from August 6 until December 31.
